Produce an executable build plan for Jira story SFCC-742 "Wishlist – Login Panel Content" in the Zimmermann PWA Kit repo at /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa.

All evidence below was gathered and verified in a completed PreBuild gate. Do NOT re-gather it. The gate table is at ~/Dev/zimmerMANN-skills/.runs/SFCC-742/findings.md — read it. Write nothing outside ~/Dev/zimmerMANN-skills/.runs/SFCC-742/.

## The story
Build a `wishlist-login-panel` content component. It is CONTENT ONLY — the drawer shell, slide-in, overlay and close trigger are owned by SFCC-736 `pdp/drawer`. This renders as children/tab-content passed into that shell. Auth logic and API integration are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE (covered by separate auth stories). 3 points, Sprint 4 (ends 2026-09-07), epic SFCC-2 PWA Kit Components, all 8 storefronts.

## The 12 acceptance criteria (Jira customfield_10231)
Panel behaviour: (1) logged-out shopper triggers wishlist → panel slides in from right via pdp/drawer shell. (2) close icon → panel dismisses, focus returns to the wishlist icon.
Content: (3) displays a heading and explanatory copy that the shopper must log in or create an account to save items. (4) an email input field and a "Send Code" button are visible for magic link / OTP login. (5) "Sign in with Apple" and "Sign in with Google" buttons are visible. (6) a "New to Zimmermann?" section with supporting copy and a "Create an Account" CTA.
Responsive: (7) at size=Large, size=Small or size=Mobile the layout matches the corresponding Figma variant.
Empty & error: (8) if panel content fails to load, no broken layout and the drawer shell remains dismissible.
Accessibility: (9) focus moves into the panel and is trapped until closed. (10) focus returns to the triggering wishlist icon on close. (11) panel has role=dialog and an appropriate aria-label. (12) meets WCAG 2.1 AA.

## Decisions Marcel has already made — treat as fixed
- **Branch base:** cut a NEW branch from an updated `origin/develop`. Do NOT branch off the drawer branch. But DESIGN THE SEAM against `origin/feature/sfcc-736-pdp-drawer-tabs` (PR #67, still in review) so that when #67 merges and is pulled in, this work stacks with zero rework. The component must be usable standalone (Storybook) without #67 present on develop.
- **Social sign-in:** build BOTH Apple and Google buttons exactly as designed. Record as a stated assumption; the PRD conflict is being raised separately with the BA.

## Verified Figma (Design System 2026, fileKey wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm)
Nodes — Large `40001889:38489` (522×523), Small `40001889:38498` (342×559), Mobile `40001897:40903` (342×503). The ticket's own link points at the whole Drawer canvas `40000938:5082`, not the panel.
`Tab=Wishlist` has ONLY `Variant=Default` — no Step 02/03, no Success, no error state (contrast `Tab=Find My Size`, which has Step 01/02/03). So "Send Code" has no designed next state; the OTP 6-box code-entry screen is NOT in this story.
Rendered content, structurally IDENTICAL across Large and Mobile (only text wrapping differs), three sections separated by two dividers:
1. Explanatory copy "You must log in or create an account to add items to your wishlist." → Email input (floating label "Email") → SEND CODE (filled dark, full-width)
2. SIGN IN WITH APPLE (outlined + Apple glyph) → SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE (outlined + Google glyph)
3. "NEW TO ZIMMERMANN?" heading → "Join for exclusive offers, early access and a more personal experience." → CREATE AN ACCOUNT (outlined)
Note: no top-level heading is rendered in the panel itself — AC3's "heading" appears to be the drawer shell's title/tab. Flag as an open question, do not invent one.

## Verified SFCC-736 shell API (from origin/feature/sfcc-736-pdp-drawer-tabs — NOT on develop yet)
`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmDrawer/index.tsx`:
- `export type ZimmDrawerSize = 'large' | 'small' | 'mobile'`
- `ZimmDrawer({ isOpen, onClose, size, children, ...aria })`, aria is a discriminated union `{labelledBy} | {'aria-label'}`
- Built on Chakra `Drawer`. Its doc comment states focus trap, initial focus, focus restore, body-scroll lock, and Escape/overlay-click-to-close ALL come from Chakra, not hand-rolled. Owns the close button.
- `zimmDrawer.css.ts` drives responsive with `@media (min-width: ${breakpoints.md})`; below the tablet breakpoint every size collapses to the mobile treatment.
`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmPdpDrawer/index.tsx`:
- `export type ZimmPdpDrawerTab = ZimmTabItem & { content: React.ReactNode }`
- `ZimmPdpDrawer({ isOpen, onClose, size, tabs, initialTabId, ariaLabel })` — renders `activeTab.content` inside a `role="tabpanel"`. SFCC-742's component is exactly such a `content` node.
CONSEQUENCE: ACs 1, 2, 9, 10, 11 are ALL satisfied by the shell. The content component must NOT reimplement focus management, role=dialog, or close. Plan how to demonstrate/assert them (Storybook against the shell once #67 lands, or an explicitly deferred note) rather than building them here.
Adopt `size: ZimmDrawerSize` as this component's prop to mirror the shell — but the component must not import from the drawer branch while it is unmerged. Decide and justify: locally declared union now with a follow-up to switch to the shared type, vs. some other seam.

## Codebase facts (verified)
- Structure convention: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/{atoms,molecules,organisms}/<camelCase>/` with `index.tsx`, `index.stories.tsx`, co-located `<name>.css.ts`, and `index.test.tsx` where there is real logic. Reference organism: `ui-kits/organisms/zimmSubscribeSection/` (4 files incl. test).
- Recipes are registered in `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts`. NOTE: that file changed on disk during this session (ZimmColourSwatches moved to `ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/`) — read its CURRENT state before planning an edit.
- Existing atoms to REUSE, do not rebuild: `ui-kits/atoms/zimmTextInput` (floating label, `trailing` slot, controlled/uncontrolled, error/helper text), `ui-kits/atoms/zimmButton` (single source of truth for button styling — never a `.zimm-btn-*` class; `variant="icon"` exists).
- Icons: `AppleIcon` and `GoogleIcon` ARE exported from `overrides/app/components/icons/index.tsx` (line ~38) but under the explicit banner "Base template extras — not in the Zimmermann Figma spec but available for use." `ZimmIcon`'s own name list has no apple/google. Always import icons from `app/components/icons`, never the base SFCC path. Note the known Vitest gotcha: ZimmIcon throws under Vitest (see .claude/rules/testing.md) — mock at the smallest surface.
- Styling rules (.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md, css.md): `textStyle` for type; raw `var(--zimm-*)` for colour/spacing — NEVER a bare Chakra token key (mechanically enforced by theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts); no raw hex/px/rem/em literals; responsive steps as explicit media queries keyed off a `BP`-style constant, never Chakra's array shorthand.
- TypeScript only under overrides/. Run `npx tsc --noEmit`.

## Tier / ownership (from CODEOWNERS, authoritative — do NOT use .claude/registry)
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/**` → CODEOWNERS:176 → `pwa-squad-a` + `pwa-squad-b`. Tier 3, plain ownership, no approval gate.
- `overrides/app/components/**/*.css.ts` → CODEOWNERS:186 → same squads.
- `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` → CODEOWNERS:117 → **Tier 2** (`tier-2-approvers` + `tier-1-approvers`). This is the ONLY protected file in the likely set.
- NO Tier 1 file is involved. Do not plan any change to theme/foundation/, ssr.js, config/, worker/main.js, .github/workflows/, or any .claude/ or AGENTS.md file.

## Open questions to carry into the plan (do not resolve by assumption)
1. Should the five pieces of copy come from `useUiCopy` (the app-wide Context, used by BottomBar and ZimmSubscribeSection) rather than being hardcoded? 8 storefronts + Transperfect translation make this material. `translations/` is Tier 2.
2. Does this component render a heading, or is AC3's heading the shell's title? (see Figma note above)
3. Do the base-template Apple/Google glyphs visually match the Figma marks?
4. Should the panel use plain `ZimmDrawer` + title, or `ZimmPdpDrawer` + a single tab? (Arguably SFCC-434's wiring decision, not this story's — but it affects the seam.)

## What to return
Goal statement · scale call (single PR vs multi-commit, with reasoning) · file manifest with tier and owner per file · ordered steps, each with concrete pass criteria (including the exact commands: `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint`, `npm run test`, `npm run audit:tokens`) · per-step loop configuration · the stated assumptions gathered in one place · the open questions above.

Respect AGENTS.md's copy-first rule ONLY if a base SFCC file needs overriding — assess whether any does; this is likely all net-new Zimmermann components, in which case say so explicitly rather than inventing a copy-first step.

Write the plan to ~/Dev/zimmerMANN-skills/.runs/SFCC-742/plan.md and return a concise summary: scale call, step count, file count with tier breakdown, and the open questions.

## Scale call

**Single branch, single PR, four commits.** `feature/SFCC-742_wishlist-login-panel-content`, cut fresh from `origin/develop` (`f7fd816`). One coherent feature, 7 files, and CODEOWNERS routes every Tier 3 file to the *same* two squads. The lone Tier 2 file is a 2-line change — splitting it to its own branch would leave branch 1 with an unregistered recipe (knowingly broken), so it gets its own **commit** instead. Commit boundaries isolate the two shared-surface touches (shared atom; Tier 2 file) so each is independently revertable.

Loop scaled down deliberately, and I named the drops: **no Playwright/`.feature`** (completes no journey without #67; `e2e_scope: skip` would apply anyway), **no per-commit Tester/Scorer cycle**, **no visual regression**, **no new hook** (≤1 `useState`, no effects — below `components.md`'s threshold), **no shared style module** (one component, one recipe). Kept: the four commands at every commit, one scoped Vitest file, one story file with the a11y gate, one CodeRabbit pass.

## Counts

**5 steps** (4 commits + pre-flight, plus a pre-PR review step). **7 files — 6 Tier 3, 1 Tier 2, 0 Tier 1.** Nothing BLOCKED.

## Copy-first: assessed and explicitly not applicable

`node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/` has **no `ui-kits/` directory** — no mirrored path exists, so this is 100% net-new. Base SFCC *does* ship `social-login/`, `passwordless-login/`, `otp-auth/`, and I checked whether they were the right override target. They are not, for three independent reasons: `SocialLogin` calls `useAuthHelper(AuthHelpers.AuthorizeIDP)` (auth, out of scope), `PasswordlessLogin` demands a react-hook-form instance and owns a `showPasswordView` state machine, and both import `Button` from the `shared/ui` barrel — the barrel trap, so overriding them wouldn't even pick up Zimmermann styling. They're the seam for the future auth story, recorded so nobody re-litigates it.

## Two findings that changed the brief

1. **`ZimmButton` cannot render a labelled button with a glyph.** Its discriminated union gives you label-with-no-icon or icon-only-with-no-label. The Figma social buttons need both, and `ZimmIconType` is closed at 34 entries against a Figma node with no apple/google. Plan adds an optional `leadingIcon?: React.ReactNode` (Step 1, own commit) — additive, typed as `ReactNode` so it sidesteps the locked icon set entirely, with a documented fallback if a reviewer objects to widening a shared atom.

2. **`ZimmPdpDrawer` does not thread `size` to `activeTab.content`.** Verified on `a05b257`. Combined with `zimmDrawer.css.ts` collapsing every variant to mobile below the tablet breakpoint, a naive `size`-driven layout could render mobile shell around large content. Plan keeps the prop (AC7 names it, you fixed it) but nests every variant override inside `@media (min-width: ${breakpoints.md})`, mirroring the shell exactly. The seam is a locally-declared union that is *structurally assignable* to `ZimmDrawerSize` both directions — so when #67 lands it's a one-line import swap that `tsc` verifies, zero rework.

Also worth flagging: **#67 modifies the same Tier 2 file** in the same import block, so expect a trivial additive conflict.

## Open questions

**Blocking:** (1) Does this component render a heading, or is AC3's heading the shell's tab title? Plan assumes no heading; a "yes" changes Step 3 markup and Step 4 assertions.

**Non-blocking:** (2) Copy-source ownership — I dissolved most of this one: `t(key, fallback)` returns the fallback with no Provider and for unknown keys, so building with `useUiCopy` is strictly dominant and reversible. The residual is only key naming and whether `translations/` is the right home. (3) Apple/Google glyph parity with Figma. (4) `ZimmDrawer` + title vs `ZimmPdpDrawer` + single tab. (5) **New** — does the social glyph recolour with the label on hover/active/disabled? No Figma node answers it, and it's the only genuinely new interactive state in the story. (6) **New** — who sets `size`, given the shell doesn't thread it?

On interactive states: the panel introduces no control with new states of its own — hover/focus/active/disabled for all five controls already exist and are signed off in `zimmButton.css.ts` and `zimmTextInput.css.ts`. Figma confirms that's correct rather than a gap (`Tab=Wishlist` has only `Variant=Default` because the states live on the atoms). Question 5 is the one real exception, and I raised it rather than leaving it for the Tester.
